title: Fractional Dichromatic Number and Domination in Tournaments
summary: Bourneuf, Charbit and Thomassé [BCT25] showed that the domination number of a tournament can be bounded as a function of its fractional dichromatic number. The function proved was exponential and the tools were based on VC-dimension. In this paper, we present two new proofs of this theorem. The first proof is based on a reduction to the problem of bounding the domination number of a $(1/2-ε)$-majority tournament, for which [BCT25] and Charikar, Ramakrishnan and Wang [CRW26] gave tight bounds.
